title: Who is who in Going Places
back: Sophie (dreamer), Jansie (realist), Geoff (silent brother), the father (wild stories), Danny Casey (the hero in the stands).

title: Going Places in six beats
back: Boutique dreams → Geoff's world → invented meeting → father and Jansie → the canal → Saturday's goal.

title: Going places?
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="The idiom says success; the story says she goes nowhere" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><path d="M40,150 L280,40 M274.0,48.0 L280,40 L270.0,39.3" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><rect x="230" y="130" width="70" height="30" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="4"/><text x="265" y="150" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">factory</text><g><circle cx="60" cy="131.6" r="6.6" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M51.0,146.2 Q60,138.2 69.0,146.2 L76.2,185 H43.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">The idiom says success; the story says she goes nowhere</text></svg>
back: The only places Sophie goes are in her head: arcade, canal, stadium, the biscuit factory. Gentle irony.
